text:
Ravi: onboarding report: sample app fails on Cloud Run with "Cannot find module 'redwood-js-sdk'" when deployed as an ESM service.
Cam: Cloud Run uses node ESM if package sets type=module or .mjs. Do we accidentally ship CJS-first artifacts?
Heather: package.json currently has main->dist/cjs/index.cjs, module->dist/esm/index.mjs, types->dist/types/index.d.ts and no exports map. That confuses packagers.
Femi: no exports map = consumer tooling heuristics pick wrong entry. For edge/cloud runtimes we should add a conditional exports map with an explicit edge subpath.
Ravi: also saw auth token refresh failing on edge: retry logic depended on setImmediate/process.nextTick. Workers/edge don't have those.
Cam: solution checklist: 1) add exports map: {".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs"},"./edge":"./dist/esm/edge-entry.mjs"} 2) create dist/esm/edge-entry.mjs that only uses web-safe apis.
Heather: 3) refactor auth into src/auth/core.ts -> build to dist/auth/core.{mjs,cjs} and import it from both bundles to keep behavior identical. Avoid node-only timing APIs inside core.
Femi: 4) update sample app to do a runtime-detect import: const isEdge = typeof globalThis?.WebSocket==='function' || process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME==='edge'; const sdk = await import(isEdge ? 'redwood-js-sdk/edge' : 'redwood-js-sdk');
Ravi: 5) CI: add smoke job that runs sample under wrangler and vercel dev to catch edge regressions.
Cam: dev note: TS types should remain top-level "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts". Do not rely on types inside exports until supported everywhere. Ensure index.d.ts re-exports only type definitions and doesn't reference cjs runtime paths.
Heather: build note: our current bundler creates two separate full bundles which duplicated auth. Change build to externalize auth/core so both bundles import same compiled core file.
Femi: I'll open the exports + edge-entry PR. Heather take build changes. Cam will add sample readme + runtime import snippet. Ravi owns CI smoke.
CI-bot: queued job devex/edge-smoke: sample-runner.
Ravi: thanks everyone. This should reduce onboarding friction for edge users and keep SDK behavior consistent across runtimes.
